data.credibility: Management frequently guides aggressive segment targets but frequently drops them when tracking fades, though large capital outlays like the INR 1,058 crore capex are successfully delivered.

lines.line: Promised camera modules volume 190 to 200 million units in two to three years; on track.
Promised camera revenue INR 6,000 to 7,000 crores; dropped after being unmentioned.
Promised INR 3,000 crore investment for components; dropped without updates.
Promised IT revenue Rs 4,000 to 5,000 crores; raised and on track.
Promised IT market business $1.5 to $2 billion; dropped.
Promised FY26 IT revenue INR 1,500 crores; dropped.
Promised FY26 capex INR 1,100 to 1,200 crores; kept at INR 1,058 crores.
Promised washing machine production by Q2 FY27; slipping due to delays.
Promised telecom revenue INR 7,500 to 8,000 crores in FY27; slipping after lower guidance.
Promised lighting revenue INR 1,700 crores in FY27; dropped.
Promised camera module revenue INR 2,500 crores; on track.
Promised display module JV peak revenue INR 5,500 to 6,000 crores; on track.
Promised telecom revenue INR 6,700 to 7,000 crores in FY27; pending.
Promised IT hardware revenue INR 6,000 crores in current fiscal; pending.
Promised Vivo JV volume 20 to 21 million next year; pending.
Promised Q Tech revenue INR 2,500 to 3,000 crores next year; pending.
Promised IT capex INR 500 crores under IT PLI 2; pending.

overrides.reason: Target was unmentioned across subsequent quarters and removed from active tracking.

bull: Rapid compounding with 58.9% annual revenue growth over three years and 49.9% over five years, reaching ₹58,523 cr TTM.
Strong capital efficiency with a 25.2% ROE, 29.2% ROCE, and operating cash flow at 122% of reported profit.
Lightly geared balance sheet with a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.21 and working-capital days tightened from 9 to -3.
bear: EBITDA margins have narrowed from 4.5% in FY21 to 3.8% in FY26, settling at a thin 3.2% TTM.
High valuation with a P/E ratio of 50.5 against low operating margins.
Heavy revenue concentration in Mobile Phones & Other EMS at 91%, creating dependency on limited segments.
